event: A creak and thud sound, interpreted as the main entrance door closing.

sounding_object.description: Arched wooden door, dark brown, with multiple small rectangular glass panes arranged in the upper arch. It has a dark metal handle. This is the main entrance door of the house, located to the right of a large arched window when viewed from inside the main living area.

reference_object.description: Light-gray fabric armchair with a visible weave, light-colored wooden legs, and a blue and white patterned throw pillow on it. It is positioned to the right of the fireplace (when facing the fireplace) and near a large arched window. This is the armchair further from the wall painting seen above/beside the fireplace.

facing_object.description: Light-gray fabric three-seater couch with a visible weave. It has at least two throw pillows: one bright yellow, and one with a gray and white geometric pattern. It is positioned directly in front of a fireplace.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting and facing the light-gray three-seater couch, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
